note: Electro Spirit chain: one bounce every 0.25 s after the first target. Supercell December 2025 balance changes (1 December 2025): 'Electro Spirit Chain Speed: 0.2s -> 0.25 (+25%) ... Its Chain Speed is being rewired to make it less efficient at handling swarm units'; wiki Electro Spirit history 1/12/2025, the Heroes Update, 'increased it's Shock Chain Period to 0.25 seconds (from 0.2 seconds)'; no later note changes it before the games (31 August to 6 September 2026). ClashStrategic cs2.4.0 gave 0.1, which the engine never read (every bounce landed in one tick); the game data export carries no chain period. https://supercell.com/en/games/clashroyale/blog/release-notes/december-balance-changes/ https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Electro_Spirit

The evolution's own record (evo.skills.pierce.bounceDelay 0.15) still paces its bounces after the third, unchanged. https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Electro_Dragon
